1074-2085-4613.easyPrerequisites:
King Macar doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Kelpie Guide is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
1074-2085-4613.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1074-2085-4613.description:
Activate King Macar using Kelpie Guide's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Kelpie Guide's ability by tapping it, untapping King Macar
King Macar triggers, allowing you to exile a creature and create a Gold token if you do.
Repeat.

116-512-7308.easyPrerequisites:
Mona Lisa and Kiora's Follower do not have summoning sickness.
Mona Lisa has power 2 or greater.
116-512-7308.description:
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Kiora's Follower and Mona Lisa, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
116-512-7308.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Mona Lisa's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

1339-3899-4616.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-3899-4616.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

872-1174-7857.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
You control a mana-producing land.
872-1174-7857.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Elven Raft-Steerer  triggers, untapping Scaled Herbalist.
Activate the land and another land by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping another land.
Repeat.

1174-3177-7857.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
You control a mana-producing land.
1174-3177-7857.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Elven Raft-Steerer  triggers, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout.
Activate the land and another land by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping another land.
Repeat.

338-1379-5641-6830.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-1379-5641-6830.description:
Gain life in any way.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

792-1263-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-6965-7752.easyPrerequisites: You've cast a noncreature spell this turn.
3259-6965-7752.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6965-7752.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Council of Reeds triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-6965-7752.notes: If you start the combo with multiple Council of Reeds, you'll create a token for each of them. This'll result in you creating more tokens each loop for infinite tokens.

364-3923-4050-7639.description:
Cast Mystic Speculation by paying {U} due to Arcane Melee.
Namor triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve Mystic Speculation.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk, adding {U}.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

550-1618-2440-7376.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Young Pyromancer
550-1618-2440-7376.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Charnel Serenade.
Charnel Serenade triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Young Pyromancer triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Charnel Serenade.
Repeat.
550-1618-2440-7376.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Young Pyromancer. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more loyalty counters on it

1170-1177-3581-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Narset by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to look at the top four cards of your library, then reveal Sensei's Divining Top and put it into your hand.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}
Displacer Kitten and Kykar trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Narset.
Resolve the Kykar trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1594-3165-3532-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
1594-3165-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Managorger Hydra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-2638-6620.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-2638-6620.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Tireless Tracker and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Sylvan Safekeeper ability
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1636-4023-5256-6987.notablePrerequisites: Need to have a total of 5 artifact creatures
1636-4023-5256-6987.description:
Cast Robobrain War Mind by paying {3}{U}.
When Robobrain War Mind enters, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Robobrain War Mind trigger, causing you to get {E} for each artifact creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Robobrain War Mind.
Activate Dr. Madison Li by tapping it and paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, returning Robobrain War Mind from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

662-1651-5640-6218.description:
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Pheres-Band Tromper to become an artifact.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping it and Pheres-Band Tromper, targeting Pheres-Band Tromper.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying Clock of Omens' ability, targeting Clock of Omens.
Resolve both Clock of Omens abilities, untapping it and Pheres-Band Tromper.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
662-1651-5640-6218.notes: You can tap a different artifact in place of Clock of Omens if desired.

1456-3755-5051-5078.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1860-1878-2634-5195.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has four or more cards in hand.
1860-1878-2634-5195.description:
Activate Emergence Zone's second ability by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it,  allowing you to cast spells as though they have flash this turn.
Cast Jeska's Will by paying {2}{R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Jeska's Will.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Jeska's Will copy, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 5.
1860-1878-2634-5195.notes: If you control a commander, you can choose both of Jeska's Will's modes if desired.

1018-4067-4306-6281.description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Skullwinder.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Skullwinder that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Skullwinder token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Skullwinder from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Repeat.

1737-2707-4872-6504.manaNeeded: {1} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
1737-2707-4872-6504.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Conjurer's Bauble.
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate the Conjurer's Bauble token by tapping and sacrificing it, putting Time Warp onto the bottom of your library from your graveyard, and then causing you to draw Time Warp from the bottom of your library due to River Song.
Repeat each turn.

1029-5028-5986.description:
Activate Whisperer of the Wilds by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Whisperer of the Wilds.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
1029-5028-5986.notes: If mana allows, you can untap a creature using Tolarian Kraken's third trigger - although it is not necessary to execute the combo.

1737-2438-3621-4853.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {8} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, Su-Chi Cave Guard and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi Cave Guard trigger, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

225-565-1987-2556.notablePrerequisites:
You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-565-1987-2556.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting Mnemonic Wall and the mana-producing land.
Orvar triggers, creating a copy of the mana-producing land.
When the land token enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers.
Holding priority, activate the nontoken land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate the nontoken land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger from step 3, untapping it.
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking the land and Mnemonic Wall.
When the land and Mnemonic Wall enter the battlefield, Mnemonic Wall and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land token.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger from step 8, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
225-565-1987-2556.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may cast Ghostly Flicker targeting any other permanent(s).

1247-3291-5963.notablePrerequisites:
Karametra's Acolyte does not have summoning sickness. Your devotion to green is at least two.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
1247-3291-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Karametra's Acolyte's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

3719-4890-4893-5326.notablePrerequisites: Dack's Duplicate has a power of at least 2.
3719-4890-4893-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Dack's Duplicate and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Dack's Duplicate from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Dack's Duplicate to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Dack's Duplicate enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Dack's Duplicate by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Creature with MV<=3 that has "When ~ enters, you get at least {E}"

678-4050-5674--40.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least {E}.
You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
678-4050-5674--40.description:
Cast the creature that causes you to get energy counter(s) when it enters the battlefield by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers.
When the creature enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get at least {E}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1339-1636-5162.notablePrerequisites: Kwain does not have summoning sickness.
1339-1636-5162.description:
Activate Kwain by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life, and allowing each opponent to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1225-1432-1719-5295.notablePrerequisites:
Vizier of Tumbling Sands and Ioreth of the Healing House do not have summoning sickness.
There is at least one other legendary creature on the battlefield.
The Eleventh Hour has exactly two lore counters on it.
1225-1432-1719-5295.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Eleventh Hour triggers, putting a lore counter on itself.
The Eleventh Hour's third chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of Vizier of Tumbling Sands that is a legendary creature named Prisoner Zero.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House's second ability by tapping it, untapping Prisoner Zero and any other legendary creature.
Activate Prisoner Zero by tapping it, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Repeat from step 3.

2557-3199-3209.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three opponents.
You control at least two untapped creatures, one of which must be green.
2557-3199-3209.description:
Activate Spellbinding Soprano's encore ability by paying {3}{R} and exiling it from your graveyard, creating a token copy of it with haste for each opponent you have.
Declare each Spellbinding Soprano token as an attacker.
Each Spellbinding Soprano token triggers, causing instant and sorcery spells you cast this turn to cost {1} less to cast for each Spellbinding Soprano token.
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by tapping a green creature and any other creature you control, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens and returning Sprout Swarm to your hand.
Repeat step 4.

57-914-2534.notablePrerequisites:
Feldon does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
57-914-2534.description:
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist with haste.
The Dockside Extortionist token enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Coercive Recruiter.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Coercive Recruiter trigger, untapping Feldon.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

1636-1993-4300.notablePrerequisites:
You have a land card on the battlefield that enters the battlefield untapped and can produce at least {1}.
You control fewer than nine lands.
Budoka Gardener does not have summoning sickness.
1636-1993-4300.description:
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning the land to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
The Illusion enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

1376-2816.easyPrerequisites: Umbral Mantle attached to Priest of Titania.
1376-2816.notablePrerequisites: Priest of Titania does not have summoning sickness. There are at least three Elves on the battlefield.
1376-2816.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Priest of Titania by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
